select FileNme, busGrp
from
(
Select ba.entity_id, b.book_name, tr.trade_status, trunc(modif_date) as amend_date, bav.attribute_name as crd_Book, modif_date,

case when bav.attribute_name = 'ABMObook' then 'PnlByTradeDetails_ABS_' 
when bav.attribute_name = 'AsiaCreditMObook' then 'PnlByTradeDetails_CRD_Asia_'
 when bav.attribute_name = 'CreditMObook' then 'PnlByTradeDetails_CRD_'
 when bav.attribute_name = 'LondonCreditMObook' then 'PnlByTradeDetails_CRD_London_'
 else 'NA' end as FileNme,
 case when bav.attribute_name = 'ABMObook' then 'CRD-ABS' 
when bav.attribute_name = 'AsiaCreditMObook' then 'CRD-ASC'
 when bav.attribute_name = 'CreditMObook' then 'CRD-CRD'
 when bav.attribute_name = 'LondonCreditMObook' then 'CRD-LOC'
 else 'NA' end as busGrp
from CALYPSODBA.BO_AUDIT ba INNER JOIN CALYPSODBA.TRADE tr ON tr.trade_id = ba.entity_id  inner join CALYPSODBA.BOOK_ATTR_VALUE bav on tr.book_id = bav.book_id
INNER JOIN CALYPSODBA.BOOK b on b.book_id = tr.book_id
where ba.entity_class_name = 'Trade'  
and bav.attribute_name in ('ABMObook', 'CreditMObook', 'AsiaCreditMObook', 'LondonCreditMObook') and bav.ATTRIBUTE_VALUE = 'Yes'
and ba.modif_date > = TRUNC(SYSDATE - 1, 'DD') and ba.Modif_date < TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'DD')
and entity_id in 
(Select t.trade_id
from CALYPSODBA.TRADE t
inner join  CALYPSODBA.BOOK_ATTR_VALUE b on b.book_id = t.book_id
WHERE ATTRIBUTE_NAME in ('ABMObook', 'CreditMObook', 'AsiaCreditMObook', 'LondonCreditMObook') AND ATTRIBUTE_VALUE ='Yes' and 
t.trade_status NOT in ('CH_AFFIRMED' , 'CH_PENDING' , 'CH_REJECT' , 'CONSENT_PENDING' , 'DAY_RECONCILED' , 'DAY_TERMINATED' , 'DAY_TERM_ERROR' , 
'DAY_TRM_ERR_APRV' , 'FCM_REJECT' , 'FCM_REJECT_HOLD' , 'FO_REVIEW_NPF' , 'MO_APPROVED' , 'NC_CANCELED' , 'NC_CONSENT_PEND' , 'NC_PENDING' , 
'PLACEHOLDER' , 'PRICING' , 'RISK_OTHER' , 'SENT_TO_CH' , 'INVALID' , 'MO_APPROVED' , 'PRICING_MAT' , 'RECONCILED', 'TERMINATED')))
group by FileNme, busGrp

update [tbl_Trade_CreditAudit]
set Economic_Change = 'Economic'
FROM [OtcTradeAuditing].[dbo].[tbl_Trade_CreditAudit]
where Amendment not in('-0.00','0','0.00')
and Economic_Change is null
and cast(substring(business_date,0,len(Business_Date)-6) as date) >= cast(getdate()-7 as date)and cast(substring(business_date,0,len(Business_Date)-6) as date) < cast(getdate() as date)

update [tbl_Trade_CreditAudit]
set Economic_Change = 'Economic'
FROM [OtcTradeAuditing].[dbo].[tbl_Trade_CreditAudit]
where Amendment_Cash not in('-0.00','0','0.00')
and Economic_Change is null
and cast(substring(business_date,0,len(Business_Date)-6) as date) >= cast(getdate()-7 as date)and cast(substring(business_date,0,len(Business_Date)-6) as date) < cast(getdate() as date)

update [tbl_Trade_CreditAudit]
set Economic_Change = 'Non_Economic'
FROM [OtcTradeAuditing].[dbo].[tbl_Trade_CreditAudit]
where Amendment in('-0.00','0','0.00')
and Economic_Change is null
and cast(substring(business_date,0,len(Business_Date)-6) as date) >= cast(getdate()-7 as date)and cast(substring(business_date,0,len(Business_Date)-6) as date) < cast(getdate() as date)

update [tbl_Trade_CreditAudit]
set Economic_Change = 'Non_Economic'
FROM [OtcTradeAuditing].[dbo].[tbl_Trade_CreditAudit]
where Amendment_Cash in('-0.00','0','0.00')
and Economic_Change is null
and cast(substring(business_date,0,len(Business_Date)-6) as date) >= cast(getdate()-7 as date)and cast(substring(business_date,0,len(Business_Date)-6) as date) < cast(getdate() as date)



update [dbo].[tbl_Trade_CreditAudit]
set EconomicChange_Exist = 'Y'
From [OtcTradeAuditing].[dbo].[tbl_Trade_CreditAudit] CA
inner join (select distinct Calypso_Reference, Business_Date From [dbo].[tbl_Trade_CreditAudit] where Economic_Change = 'Economic') EC
on CA.Business_Date = EC.Business_Date and 
   CA.Calypso_Reference = EC.Calypso_Reference


update [dbo].[tbl_Trade_CreditAudit]
set EconomicChange_Exist = 'N'
From [OtcTradeAuditing].[dbo].[tbl_Trade_CreditAudit] 
where EconomicChange_Exist is null

select count(Date_Added) as TTL FROM OtcTradeAuditing.dbo.tbl_Trade_CreditAudit
where cast([Date_Added] as date) = cast(getdate() as date) 
  and charindex('CVA', Business_Grp , 1) = 0
